name: Mi sot hau
summary: Mỳ sốt hàu is noodles with an oyster sauce. The national tourism authority lists it with dishes made from Đầm Lập An oysters and does not describe the noodles.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam, article updated 16 May 2016. The printed spelling is mỳ sốt hàu.
howToEat: Order it at the lagoon. The article does not name a shop or a noodle.
A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Lập An. No street number is printed.
seoTitle: Mi sot hau in Lang Co — noodles and oyster
seoDescription: Mỳ sốt hàu is noodles with an oyster sauce on Đầm Lập An. The 2016 tourism article names it. A price is Check on arrival.
